column1: # Everyday words whose names and keywords lead somewhere few people mean.
# Format: word<TAB>items, as in related.tsv. Searching for the whole word
# lists the items first, in this order, after any alias of the word and
# before everything the word names through a Unicode name or CLDR keyword:
# `book` names the dingbat BOOK, but most people want the open book. While
# the word is still being typed, the items rank like any other match, and a
# preferred word does not change an item's rank. A word may be in only one
# of aliases.tsv, related.tsv and this file.
